overview_description.description: Flutterwave is a financial technology company that provides payment infrastructure for businesses, financial institutions, and developers, enabling them to accept and send payments across multiple markets and payment methods. Its platform supports services such as online payment processing, payouts, invoicing, payment links, e-commerce tools, and APIs for building financial applications. The company facilitates transactions through channels including cards, bank transfers, mobile money, and other local payment options, helping organizations operate across different countries and currencies. Flutterwave also offers tools for businesses of various sizes to manage collections, disbursements, and customer payments through a unified platform. In addition, it provides services for cross-border money transfers and financial management, supporting both commercial and individual users.
